name: [ALIENS 👽] Rope an Animal
desc:
🤠 Welcome to Rope an Animal!

How to Play:
🪢 Rope wild animals
🐎 Ride them to safety before the Guardian catches you
💰 Earn money from your animals
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal animals from other players
🥚 Rope rare animals as soon as they hatch

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
